items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1959-11-08
items.q: They don't have many older musicians out there now... Billy Wright. He's a guitar player, he used to play the guitar in the band. Well he used to play in Marshall Lawrence

ctx.x: I ain't even had a chance to go out there to the funeral. See? Yeah. So well, that make all of them dead. They don't have many older musicians out there now. Marshall Lawrence is the oldest they got than my daddy so far. Oh yeah, they got another fellow. Billy Wright. He's a guitar player, he used to play the guitar in the band. Well he used to play in Marshall Lawrence, he used to play a 12 string guitar.
